title: galium palustre var. constrictum
intro: Galium palustre var. constrictum, commonly known as the narrow-leaved marsh bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it has been used to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Galium palustre var. constrictum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
